name: chautauqua-backend
description: Lambda functions for Chautauqua calendar generation

scripts.build: npm run test && npm run build:prod
scripts.build:prod: npm run build:publisher-refs && npx esbuild src/handlers/calendarHandler.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --outfile=dist/calendarHandler.js --external:aws-sdk --external:@aws-sdk/client-dynamodb --external:@aws-sdk/client-s3 --external:@aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb --external:ical-generator --external:date-fns --external:cheerio --external:axios --external:uuid --external:node-fetch && npx esbuild src/handlers/adminHandler.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --outfile=dist/adminHandler.js --external:aws-sdk --external:@aws-sdk/client-dynamodb --external:@aws-sdk/client-s3 --external:@aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb --external:@aws-sdk/client-secrets-manager --external:@aws-sdk/client-sesv2 --external:@aws-sdk/client-lambda --external:ical-generator --external:date-fns --external:cheerio --external:axios --external:uuid --external:node-fetch --external:googleapis --external:jsonwebtoken && npx esbuild src/handlers/syncHandler.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --outfile=dist/syncHandler.js --external:@aws-sdk/client-dynamodb --external:@aws-sdk/client-s3 --external:@aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb && npx esbuild src/handlers/publisherIngestHandler.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --outfile=dist/publisherIngestHandler.js --external:@aws-sdk/client-dynamodb --external:@aws-sdk/client-s3 --external:@aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb && cp -r src/services dist/ && cp -r src/types dist/ && rm -rf dist/refs && cp -r ../tools/publisher-format/dist/refs dist/refs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && zip -r lambda-function.zip dist/ package.json && aws lambda update-function-code --function-name chautauqua-calendar-generator --zip-file fileb://lambda-function.zip
scripts.package: npm run build:prod && zip -r lambda-function.zip dist/ package.json node_modules/
scripts.package:lambda: npm run build:prod && zip -r lambda-function.zip dist/ package.json node_modules/
scripts.package:terraform: npm run build:prod && zip -r lambda-function.zip dist/ package.json
scripts.validate: npm run type-check && npm run lint
